name: Thinking While Driving (LLM Traffic Simulation)
description: A Unity-based traffic simulation framework that evaluates LLM-powered agents in real-time urban routing scenarios. A central RoadManager component tracks all agent movements and computes global congestion states, which are fed back into agent prompts via live data feeds, forcing continuous route adaptation. The framework uses graph-based world models and supports both sequential and concurrent planners, testing agents on immediate decision-making under dynamic environmental feedback.
reputation: Research framework demonstrating real-time LLM adaptation to dynamic environmental state; cited as an example of immediate feedback loop evaluation for agentic systems.
notes: Built on Unity engine. RoadManager provides real-time congestion computation. Tests real-time interaction rather than offline reasoning. Demonstrates dynamism via continuous environmental state updates rather than static prompts.
